html:
D158　汇总多轮稳定性与成本

第 23 周 · 2 小时。前置阅读为 D157-按状态与工具记录判定结果。验证版本为 Node.js 20.19.6、pnpm 10.28.0、Vitest 4.1.12；接口运行于本机 NestJS 与 PostgreSQL。

今天要做出什么

让原有十题支持重复运行。实现命中次数、全轮答对、至少一次答对、输出稳定性、总步数、输入输出 token 和整体 P95 的计算。

目录与时间

★ apps/server/test/evaluation/metrics.spec.ts
★ apps/server/test/evaluation/metrics.ts
★ apps/server/test/diagnosis.e2e-spec.ts

★ 为本章新建或修改的文件。闭卷 10 分钟，知识点 35 分钟，动手 55 分钟，自检与提交 20 分钟。优先完成必做用例，超时先跳过拓展。工作日到 1 小时 40 分先停选做内容，留 20 分钟做必做自检。完整回归的等待时间另计。

零、闭卷回忆

D157　只读动作的违规如何判断？

核对答案

检查工单状态、版本、处理或审批记录增量以及越界调用。

D155　不完整的材料如何标注？

核对答案

保留 unknown，让模型有表达证据不足的正确出口。

D151　受保护资源如何引导客户端发现签发者？

核对答案

401 挑战指向资源元数据，其中列出签发者。

再复测错题本中今天到期的条目。

一、知识点与可运行示例

1.1 先确定分母再计算稳定性

每轮要求覆盖相同十个唯一 ID，失败和超时仍在分母中。相同题在所有轮次输出同一类别及停止原因算稳定；稳定答错同样算稳定。因此需要并列报告命中与稳定。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run test/evaluation/metrics.spec.ts -t "同题跨轮分歧会降低稳定题数和全对题数"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/evaluation/metrics.spec.ts，第四节列出本章源码；复用的夹具可按导入路径在前置讲义中查阅。

  it('同题跨轮分歧会降低稳定题数和全对题数', () => {
    const other = round.map((x, i) => i === 0 ? { ...x, predicted: null, reason: 'model_failed', ms: 200 } : x);
    expect(summarize([round, other])).toMatchObject({ attempts: 20, hits: 19, answered: 19,
      alwaysCorrect: 9, everCorrect: 10, stable: 9, p95Ms: 10, estimatedCost: null });
    expect(() => summarize([round, other.slice(1)])).toThrow('EVAL_INCOMPLETE');
  });

推导题　一题三轮只答对一次，这题贡献哪些指标？

答案

逐次命中贡献一次，至少一次命中贡献一题，全轮答对不计；三轮输出不同时不算稳定。

1.2 延迟和成本使用原始计量

合并所有尝试后排序，用向上取整的最近秩选 P95。输入和输出 token 分开累加，提供单价后按每百万 token 计算估算费用。本机实验没有账单单价，保留空值。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run test/evaluation/metrics.spec.ts -t "输入和输出按各自单价计量"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/evaluation/metrics.spec.ts，第四节列出本章源码；复用的夹具可按导入路径在前置讲义中查阅。

  it('输入和输出按各自单价计量', () => {
    expect(summarize([round], { inputPerMillion: 1, outputPerMillion: 5 }).estimatedCost).toBeCloseTo(0.0002, 8);
    expect(() => summarize([[{ ...round[0], tokens: 0 }, ...round.slice(1)]])).toThrow('计量无效');
  });

推导题　为什么不平均三个 P95？

答案

每轮的分位数不能还原所有样本的联合分布。合并原始延迟才能得到整批尝试的 P95。

二、自己动手

步骤 1　让已有采集器多跑几轮

提示一 · 方向

重复次数缺省为一，保留之前的逐题记录格式并补输入、输出 token。

提示二 · API

EVAL_REPEATS、EVAL_METRICS_FILE、diagnosis.e2e-spec.ts。

提示三 · 实现顺序

先采一轮并校验题目完整性，再重复，最后把完整原始轮次传入 summarize。

步骤 2　分别报告质量和代价

提示一 · 方向

先统计按次命中，再按题分组，并在原始耗时上计算 P95。

提示二 · API

score、summarize、Math.ceil。

提示三 · 实现顺序

验证 token 字段相加相等；无单价返回 null，有单价分开换算。

三、自检与提交

用纸笔复算示例里的 19/20、9/10 和 P95，再解释哪一个数字能回答业务问题。

反证 A　在 apps/server/test/evaluation/metrics.ts 把 x.hits === rounds.length 临时替为 x.hits > 0，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

AssertionError: expected { rounds: 2, attempts: 20, …(11) } to match object { attempts: 20, hits: 19, …(6) }

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

反证 B　在 apps/server/test/evaluation/metrics.ts 把 outputTokens * prices.outputPerMillion 临时替为 outputTokens * prices.inputPerMillion，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

AssertionError: expected 0.00012 to be close to 0.0002, received difference is 0.00008, but expected 5e-9

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

在 apps/server 执行 pnpm exec vitest run test/evaluation/metrics.spec.ts。实际重复评测使用同一本机模型和十个固定输入，D160 给出观测值。

提交批改　提交实际 diff、一次正常输出、一条失败断言和恢复结果。说明哪一步看过提示，并说“D158 提交了”。

四、本章完整源码

下列文件按当天验证工程快照生成。

4.1 汇总多轮稳定性与成本

import { cases } from '../diagnosis-eval.js';
import { summarize } from './metrics.js';

const round = cases.map(([id, , expected], i) => ({ id, predicted: expected, reason: 'answered', ms: i + 1,
  tokens: 12, steps: 2, inputTokens: 10, outputTokens: 2 }));

describe('重复测量的分母', () => {
  it('同题跨轮分歧会降低稳定题数和全对题数', () => {
    const other = round.map((x, i) => i === 0 ? { ...x, predicted: null, reason: 'model_failed', ms: 200 } : x);
    expect(summarize([round, other])).toMatchObject({ attempts: 20, hits: 19, answered: 19,
      alwaysCorrect: 9, everCorrect: 10, stable: 9, p95Ms: 10, estimatedCost: null });
    expect(() => summarize([round, other.slice(1)])).toThrow('EVAL_INCOMPLETE');
  });

  it('输入和输出按各自单价计量', () => {
    expect(summarize([round], { inputPerMillion: 1, outputPerMillion: 5 }).estimatedCost).toBeCloseTo(0.0002, 8);
    expect(() => summarize([[{ ...round[0], tokens: 0 }, ...round.slice(1)]])).toThrow('计量无效');
  });
});

apps/server/test/evaluation/metrics.ts

import { cases, score, type Trial } from '../diagnosis-eval.js';

export type Metered = Trial & { inputTokens: number; outputTokens: number };
type Prices = { inputPerMillion: number; outputPerMillion: number };
function count(value: number) { return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0; }

// 每一轮必须覆盖相同十题。分母包含超时与未回答的尝试。
export function summarize(rounds: Metered[][], prices?: Prices) {
  if (!rounds.length || rounds.some(rows => rows.some(x =>
    ![x.ms, x.steps, x.inputTokens, x.outputTokens, x.tokens].every(count) ||
    x.inputTokens + x.outputTokens !== x.tokens))) throw new Error('计量无效');
  if (prices && Object.values(prices).some(x => !Number.isFinite(x) || x < 0)) throw new Error('单价无效');
  const scored = rounds.map(score);
  const rows = scored.flatMap(r => r.rows);
  const byCase = cases.map(([id]) => {
    const runs = rows.filter(row => row.id === id);
    return { id, hits: runs.filter(r => r.correct).length, stable: new Set(runs.map(r => JSON.stringify([r.reason, r.predicted]))).size === 1 };
  });
  const latencies = rows.map(x => x.ms).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const all = rounds.flat();
  const inputTokens = all.reduce((n, x) => n + x.inputTokens, 0), outputTokens = all.reduce((n, x) => n + x.outputTokens, 0);
  return { rounds: rounds.length, attempts: rows.length, hits: rows.filter(x => x.correct).length,
    answered: rows.filter(x => x.reason === 'answered').length, byCase,
    alwaysCorrect: byCase.filter(x => x.hits === rounds.length).length, everCorrect: byCase.filter(x => x.hits > 0).length,
    stable: byCase.filter(x => x.stable).length, p95Ms: latencies[Math.ceil(latencies.length * 0.95) - 1],
    inputTokens, outputTokens, totalSteps: rows.reduce((n, x) => n + x.steps, 0),
    estimatedCost: prices ? (inputTokens * prices.inputPerMillion + outputTokens * prices.outputPerMillion) / 1_000_000 : null };
}

apps/server/test/diagnosis.e2e-spec.ts

import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import type { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { appendFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import request from 'supertest';
import { vi } from 'vitest';
import { AppModule } from '../src/app.module.js';
import { configureApp } from '../src/app.setup.js';
import { TicketToolsService } from '../src/agent/ticket-tools.service.js';
import { ModelGateway } from '../src/assistant/model-gateway.js';
import { PrismaService } from '../src/prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { TicketFixtures } from './fixtures.js';
import { tokenIssuer } from './auth.js';
import { summarize, type Metered } from './evaluation/metrics.js';
import { cases, score } from './diagnosis-eval.js';

describe('工单诊断基线', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  let db: PrismaService;
  let fixtures: TicketFixtures;
  let auth: (name: string) => string;
  beforeAll(async () => {
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] }).compile();
    app = module.createNestApplication();
    configureApp(app);
    await app.init();
    db = app.get(PrismaService);
    fixtures = new TicketFixtures(db, 'DIA');
    auth = await tokenIssuer(app);
  });
  afterEach(() => { vi.restoreAllMocks(); vi.unstubAllEnvs(); });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await db.agentRun.deleteMany({ where: { ticketNo: { startsWith: 'DIA' } } });
    await fixtures.cleanup();
    await app.close();
  });

  async function run(description: string, manualId?: string) {
    const ticket = await fixtures.create();
    await db.ticket.update({ where: { id: ticket.id }, data: { description } });
    const api = request(app.getHttpServer());
    const created = await api.post('/api/agent/runs').set('authorization', auth('bob')).send({
      ticketNo: ticket.ticketNo, goal: '判断故障类别并建议下一项核查', requestKey: randomUUID(),
    }).expect(201);
    const path = '/api/agent/runs/' + created.body.data.id;
    const start = Date.now();
    const response = await api.post(path + '/diagnose').set('authorization', auth('bob')).send(manualId ? { manualId } : {}).expect(200);
    return { path, data: response.body.data, ms: Date.now() - start };
  }

  it('走已鉴权的工单读取和模型适配器', async () => {
    const model = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({
      choices: [{ index: 0, finish_reason: 'stop', message: { content: '{"category":"storage"}' } }],
    });
    const { path, data } = await run(cases[3][1]);
    expect(model.mock.calls[0]?.[0][1]?.content).toContain('ENOSPC');
    expect(data).toMatchObject({ status: 'succeeded', stopReason: 'answered', stepCount: 2 });
    const page = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(path + '/events').set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
    expect(page.body.data.events.at(-1).payload.answer).toContain('storage');
  });

  it('模型没有返回可用答案时记录失败', async () => {
    vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({ choices: [] });
    const { data } = await run(cases[0][1]);
    expect(data).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed', stopReason: 'model_failed' });
  });

  it('模型选择工具后再读结构化结果并给出类别', async () => {
    const answer = (content: string) => ({ choices: [{ index: 0, finish_reason: 'stop', message: { content } }] });
    const gateway = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValueOnce(answer('{"tool":"ticket_alert_counts"}'))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(answer('{"category":"unknown"}'));
    const { data } = await run(cases[8][1]);
    expect(data).toMatchObject({ stepCount: 4, stopReason: 'answered' });
    expect(gateway.mock.calls[1]?.[0][1]?.content).toContain('"counts":[]');
  });

  it('模型选择未加载的主题时结束运行', async () => {
    vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({
      choices: [{ index: 0, finish_reason: 'stop', message: { content: '{"tool":"ticket_history_page"}' } }],
    });
    const { data } = await run(cases[0][1]);
    expect(data.stopReason).toBe('model_failed');
  });

  it('工单和文档中的操作描述只进入证据字段', async () => {
    const material = '历史工单引用手册：恢复后由值班员复核关单。';
    const model = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({
      choices: [{ index: 0, finish_reason: 'stop', message: { content: '{"tool":"close_ticket"}' } }],
    });
    const group = await db.group.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'ops-a' } });
    const manual = await db.retrievalManual.create({ data: { groupId: group.id, title: '值班交接流程', body: '提交申请后等待值班组长复核。' } });
    const { data, path } = await run(material, manual.id).finally(() => db.retrievalManual.delete({ where: { id: manual.id } }));
    expect(data.stopReason).toBe('model_failed');
    const messages = model.mock.calls[0][0];
    expect(messages[0].content).not.toContain(material);
    const evidence = JSON.parse(String(messages[1].content));
    expect(evidence.evidenceType).toBe('untrusted_ticket_material');
    expect(JSON.stringify(evidence.evidence)).toContain(material);
    expect(evidence.document).toMatchObject({ sourceKey: 'manual:' + manual.id, quote: { text: manual.body } });
    expect(messages[0].content).not.toContain(manual.body);
    const runId = path.split('/').at(-1)!;
    expect(await db.closeApproval.count({ where: { runId } })).toBe(0);
    const calls = await db.auditLog.findMany({ where: { action: 'agent.tool_call', before: { path: ['runId'], equals: runId } } });
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(1);
  });
  it('已停用的检索手册不会送入模型', async () => {
    const group = await db.group.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'ops-a' } });
    const manual = await db.retrievalManual.create({ data: { groupId: group.id, title: '旧版手册', body: '过去的处置记录', active: false } });
    const model = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete');
    try {
      const { data } = await run('核对处置参考', manual.id);
      expect(data).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed', stopReason: 'tool_failed' });
      expect(model).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    } finally { await db.retrievalManual.delete({ where: { id: manual.id } }); }
  });
  it('手册翻页重新检查归属、版本和启用状态', async () => {
    const group = await db.group.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'ops-a' } });
    const row = await db.retrievalManual.create({ data: { groupId: group.id, title: '手册版本', body: '甲'.repeat(260) } });
    try {
      vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({ choices: [] });
      const { path } = await run('核对手册', row.id);
      const api = request(app.getHttpServer());
      const url = path + '/tools/manuals/' + row.id;
      const snapshot = await api.get(path + '/tools/contexts/2').set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
      const ref = JSON.parse(snapshot.body.data.messages[1].content).document;
      expect(ref).toMatchObject({ sourceKey: 'manual:' + row.id, offset: 0 });
      expect(ref).not.toHaveProperty('quote');
      const first = await api.get(url).set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
      const cursor = { revision: first.body.data.revision, offset: first.body.data.next };
      await api.get(url).query(cursor).set('authorization', auth('alice')).expect(404);
      const second = await api.get(url).query(cursor).set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
      expect(second.body.data.quote.text).toBe('甲'.repeat(20));
      await db.retrievalManual.update({ where: { id: row.id }, data: { body: '替换后的正文' } });
      await api.get(url).query(cursor).set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(409);
      await db.retrievalManual.update({ where: { id: row.id }, data: { active: false } });
      await api.get(url).set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(404);
    } finally { await db.retrievalManual.delete({ where: { id: row.id } }); }
  });

  it('回放接口返回送入网关的完整脱敏消息', async () => {
    const gateway = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({ choices: [] });
    const { path } = await run('诊断记录 Bearer sample-opaque');
    const api = request(app.getHttpServer());
    const route = path + '/tools/contexts/2';
    const replay = await api.get(route).set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
    expect(replay.body.data.messages).toEqual(gateway.mock.calls[0]![0]);
    expect(JSON.stringify(replay.body.data.messages)).not.toContain('sample-opaque');
    await api.get(route).set('authorization', auth('alice')).expect(404);
    await api.get(path + '/tools/contexts/1').set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(404);
  });

  it('工单转出班组后不再把已读取的材料发给模型', async () => {
    const tools = app.get(TicketToolsService);
    const batch = tools.batch.bind(tools);
    const target = await db.group.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'ops-b' } });
    vi.spyOn(tools, 'batch').mockImplementationOnce(async (...args) => {
      const result = await batch(...args);
      const row = await db.agentRun.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: args[1] } });
      await db.ticket.update({ where: { ticketNo: row.ticketNo }, data: { groupId: target.id } });
      return result;
    });
    const model = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete');
    const { data } = await run('磁盘容量复核');
    expect(data).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed', stopReason: 'tool_failed' });
    expect(model).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it.skipIf(process.env.OPS_REAL_DIAGNOSIS !== '1')('本机模型逐项评测', async () => {
    vi.stubEnv('LLM_BASE_URL', 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1');
    vi.stubEnv('LLM_API_KEY', 'local-ollama');
    vi.stubEnv('LLM_MODEL', 'tinyllama:latest');
    vi.stubEnv('LLM_MODEL_ROUTES', '');
    const repeats = Number(process.env.EVAL_REPEATS ?? '1');
    if (!Number.isInteger(repeats) || repeats < 1 || repeats > 5) throw new Error('重复次数必须为一到五');
    const rounds: Metered[][] = [];
    for (let repeat = 0; repeat < repeats; repeat++) {
      const trials: Metered[] = [];
      for (const [id, description] of cases) {
        const { data, path, ms } = await run(description);
        const api = request(app.getHttpServer());
        const trace = await api.get(path + '/traces').set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
        const events = await api.get(path + '/events').set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
        const answer = events.body.data.events.at(-1).payload.answer as string | null;
        const usage = trace.body.data.usage;
        trials.push({ id, predicted: answer?.split(' · ')[0] ?? null, reason: data.stopReason,
          steps: data.stepCount, ms, inputTokens: usage.inputTokens, outputTokens: usage.outputTokens, tokens: usage.inputTokens + usage.outputTokens });
      }
      const report = score(trials);
      console.info('本机诊断基线', JSON.stringify(report));
      if (process.env.D111_EVIDENCE_FILE) appendFileSync(process.env.D111_EVIDENCE_FILE,
        JSON.stringify({ case: 'diagnosis', model: 'tinyllama:latest', ...report }) + '\n');
      expect(report.total).toBe(10);
      rounds.push(trials);
    }
    if (process.env.EVAL_METRICS_FILE) appendFileSync(process.env.EVAL_METRICS_FILE,
      JSON.stringify(summarize(rounds)) + '\n');
  }, 360_000);
});

五、核心面试题

  1. 输出稳定可以等价于答得好吗？　要点：不能。
  2. 失败请求是否进入延迟和成功率统计？　要点：本评测把所有尝试纳入分母，连同其停止原因记录实际延迟。
  3. 没有供应商账单时怎么报告成本？　要点：报告输入输出 token、调用步数及模型版本，有明确单价才计算估算金额。

完整面试题

六、个人建议
